This LG model seems to cook so much faster that it is going to take some time to get everything correct. I tried a cake in a cake pan and it didn't rise properly, especially in the corners, and was done almost 10 minutes before the box direction times, which threw me off. No idea why. I did 2 homemade pizzas and those didn't come out as well as I expected. They showed signs of being done, but they were not. Bottom of the crust was golden and toppings were nicely done, but the crust was not done right under the fillings. As stated, it is going to take some time to adjust to. I have to learn when to use convection and when to use regular mode. But it is always fun to experiment. It is the start of BBQ season and I am a pro at that. I do love the built in air fry mode on my range. That works great. The broil functions on this range and my old one is like night and day. This on low broil is so much better and quicker than my last. Haven't tried high broil yet, I think that it will be great for reverse searing roasts from the sous vide without raising the internal temperature. The cooktop is great, the ease of use and the steadiness of the temperatures work perfectly. The biggest nightmare was getting the Smart function to work. 4 times and 6 hours of contact with LG support and I could not get it to connect to my phone. 3 of the 4 contacts tried everything they could think of. One I ended the chat with after a half hour when he told me my model didn't have the Snart feature while I am looking at the Smart button on my range. My cable router turned oput to be the secret that I discovered myself. The most advanced that my cable provider makes where 5G tries to rule the roost. It took a reset of the router so that the 2.4G network was then available and I was able to connect. Had to do the same thing the next day to get it to hook to my tablet. It truly is way too soon to give a proper review of my new range, but I feel that I am going to really like it. It is a true learning curve that i will master more when colder weather sets back in and i have the time to monitor my preparations and cook times.

At the end, regardless of heat drying, the inside seems very wet. The clean dishes smell like dish soap, I don't trust it's rinsing well. After 9 months, the dishwasher keeps locking out with a beeping, I think it's some type of power surge warning, but I doubt we are having power surges (4th time in 10 days it's beeps and locks). I have to unplug it and replug it to stop beeping and function again. I'm almost ready to call on the warranty. Lame that it wont accept liquid dish soap, I'd prefer it to see if the pods are the problem with the lack of rinsing properly. The buttons/controls are cryptic and really basic, they could have done a better job. There is no outside indication when the dishwasher has finished, it would be nice for an outside LED light indication it's operating or finished as it can be quite quiet and you don't know the status. I will buy the rest of the matching Cafe appliances when my kitchen is ready to be redone. However, if I were doing it again, I'd get the single door dishwasher, I don't think this 2 door design is perfected for washing/rinsing. 5 Stars for appearance/style and the solid handle, 1 or 2 stars for how cheap a lot of the rest feels, thin metal, less than perfect wash/rinse, lots of thin plastic inside, and 0 stars for beeping/error in less than 1 year.

Comments (English): [ Washes dishes; some issues ] || ---------------- || I had a lower feature version of this dishwasher in a previous home, which I liked. This one washes ok, but if I had to do it again I would go for the less expensive, lower feature version. Reasons: 1) ThinQ app doesn't interface with my phone. This is on a two year old phone running standard Android. No idea why and setting up the interface wasn't part of Costco install. The app feature wasn't on the cheaper dishwasher, so why pay more? Having similar issues with a washer/dryer I purchased at the same time. Won't even talk to LG's own app. 2) The app feature matters because the 'minutes to empty' is completely obscured by the kitchen counter. What is the point of a countdown that cannot be seen? The cheaper model displays on the front of the machine. I guess I would use the app if it worked.3) My preferred color is black. Easily cleaned and no fingerprints. Inexplicably, the cheaper model is available in more color combinations. 4) Upper utensil drawer is easy to forget and removes several inches of room from the main cleaning area. I'm constantly finding dishes I have to hand wash because I don't have quite enough room. This is when I remember the upper rack exists and find a very, very clean utensil I've been looking for. Lower model didn't have this third rack that seems gimmicky in the real world.Again, not a bad machine for actual cleaning, but I preferred the much cheaper model that had the same cleaning features.

Sentence (English): I have had this dishwasher for about two months and have been using it nearly every day.
Comments (English): [ Very good, but drying could be better ] || ---------------- || I have had this dishwasher for about two months and have been using it nearly every day. Overall, I like it a lot. It's well made, simple to use, very sturdy, and cleans effectively. I like the front display because you can easily see the time remaining. And I like the dirt sensor -- the dishwasher automatically adjusts the cycle length based on how dirthy the rinse water is. As a bonus, the instruction manual is written in clear, colloquial English.My main problem is with the way it dries. To get your dishes dry you'll either need to use a rinse aid, or the "extra dry" (extra hot) cycle. My solution has been to open the door a bit after the cycle runs. Not quite as convenient, but it works and avoids the extra chemicals and extra energy.When the dishwasher was new it emitted a strong odor of asphalt when it heated up -- like being on a newly paved road on a hot day -- that's what Bosch uses as insulation on the outside of the drum. I was warned about this, but I was startled by how strong it was. It eventually disipated, but was pretty unpleasant at first. There's also a chemical odor from inside the drum. Not as bad -- and that disipated, as well.

Sentence (English): I have been using the dishwasher for two weeks and these are my conclusions: 1 - Baskets: They are very practical.
Comments (English): [ Cleaning and Drying for perfect crockery ] || ---------------- || I have been using the dishwasher for two weeks and these are my conclusions: 1 - Baskets: They are very practical. Contains 3 baskets. A superior one for cutlery, which at first costs a bit to use, but when you organize it by spoons, forks, knives, etc., it is very practical since when I take out the cutlery I already have them organized to easily put them in the drawer. An intermediate one for glasses, tuppers and small objects. This basket contains two positions, one higher and one lower so that if you add tall things, either in this basket or in the lower one, they can enter without hitting the blades of the dishwasher. I think this option is great and it's super easy to use, having finger-shaped handles that make it easy to change the position. A lower basket, which does not contain a cutlery basket (it has its area in the upper basket), which gives it plenty of space for dishes or, if you fold the skewers, for objects such as saucepans, paella pans (I have tried it and ten). 2.- Programs, it has a variety of programs: Eco, Rinse, Delicate, Auto, so you can choose according to the content you are going to wash. I usually use Eco, although the program is longer, I like the option to save energy and water. To this program I add the Steam option so that the glasses come out shiny. And indeed they come out clear and without stains. And the best thing for me is that at the end of the program the door opens to finish drying the dishes! This is great. 3.- Lime Regulation Option: This option is the one I liked the most. It makes your dishwasher use more or less salt depending on your geographical area, which you have to tell it at the beginning of use, so that it softens the water and is no longer hard, which avoids the annoying traces of lime. I live in the area hard water, it's perfect for me. 4.- Program Download Option: It comes with the option of downloading an APP to manage the dishwasher from your mobile. The useful thing about this application is that it tells you the number of washes you have and when to clean the tub. It also contains options such as program delay to choose when it ends. Disadvantage: It is too tactile and sensitive, which is why I, who have small children, always have to lock the dishwasher control so that they do not modify anything. Of course, it is appreciated that it has a Screen Lock.
Comments (Original): [ Limpieza y Secado para una vajilla perfecta ] || ---------------- || Llevo dos semanas utilizando el lavavajillas y estas son mis conclusiones: 1 - Cestos: Son muy prácticos. Contiene 3 cestos. Uno superior para cubiertos, que al principio cuesta un poco de utilizar, pero cuando lo organizas por zona cucharas, tenedores, cuchillos etc es muy práctico ya que al sacar los cubiertos ya los tengo organizados para meter al cajón fácilmente. Uno intermedio para vasos, tuppers y objetos pequeños. Este cesto contiene dos posiciones, uno más alto y otro más bajo para si añades cosas altas, bien en esta cesta o en la inferior, que pueda entrar sin golpear en las aspas del lavavajillas. Esta opción me parece genial y es super fácil de usar, al tener unas asas con forma de dedos que lo hace sencillo de cambiar la posición. Un cesto inferior, que no contiene cesto de cubiertos (tiene su zona en el cesto superior), lo que le da un montón de espacio para platos o bien si pliegas los pinchos, para objetos como cacerolas, paelleras (yo lo he probado y de diez). 2.- Programas, tiene variedad de programas: Eco, Aclarado, Delicado, Auto, para que elijas según el contenido que vayas a lavar. Yo suelo usar Eco que aunque es más largo el programa me gusta la opción de ahorro de energía y agua. A este programa le añado la opción Vapor para que los vasos salgan relucientes. Y efectivamente salen claros y sin manchas. Y lo Mejor para mí, es que al final del programa la puerta se abre para que se termine de secar la vajilla!! Esto es genial. 3.- Opción Regulación de Cal: Esta opción es la que más me ha gustado. Hace que tu lavavajillas use más o menos sal en función de tu zona geográfica, que tienes que indicarle al principio del uso, para que ablande el agua y ya no sea dura, lo que evita los molestos restos de Cal. Yo que vivo en zona de agua dura, es perfecto para mí. 4.- Opción Descarga de Programas: Viene con opción de bajar una APP para gestionar el lavavajillas desde tu móvil. De esta aplicación lo útil es que te indica el número de lavados que llevas y cuando limpiar la cuba. Además contiene opciones cómo retardo de programas para elegir cuando termina. Inconveniente: Es demasiado táctil y sensible, por lo que yo que tengo niños pequeños tengo que bloquear siempre el mando del lavavajillas para que no me modifiquen nada. Eso sí es de agradecer que tiene Bloqueo de Pantalla.

Sentence (English): It has been used for a month now, and the summary is: "It's really easy to use."
Comments (English): It has been used for a month now, and the summary is: "It's really easy to use." 4.5 points, wash the grapes**. 1. Save time. I used to think that washing by hand only takes 20 minutes, but after actual experience, the dishwasher seems to solve a daily trouble. My husband washes the dishes, and I set the dishes. Things suddenly become easier. 2. Is it clean? It is as clean as washing by hand, but the dishwasher is equipped with a dryer, so there is no need to drain the water, and it feels really good to not touch the wet water at the end. The corners and corners are washed very clean. If the corners and corners are clean by hand washing, it will be a bit troublesome. Looking at the clean glass and pot lid, I feel really comfortable. 3. Is the capacity enough? A family of three is enough, and sometimes we only need to wash in layers. But if the dishwasher conditions permit, you must buy a large one, because you will want to put all kinds of pots and pans in it and wash them clean. 4. Does it cost water and electricity? 10T is the second-level energy efficiency, and compared with *3000, it mainly consumes more power. But counting it down to dozens of yuan a year, compared to the price difference of several hundred, I think 10T is still very fragrant. I don't know exactly how much more water it costs than washing by hand, but I don't see my husband wasting water, so I don't waste water. 5. Are the consumables expensive? Count it down to about 1 yuan per time (including water and electricity). The disadvantage is that some people make a lot of noise when washing dishes. My house is an independent kitchen, and washing dishes somewhat affects watching TV or chatting in the living room. (You can solve this problem by making an appointment to wash it.) The master installer is also very careful. I removed the cabinet and a drawer for the oven in my house. I charged 320 yuan and took three hours. I think it is worth it.

I used to think that washing by hand only takes 20 minutes, but after actual experience, the dishwasher seems to solve a daily trouble. My husband washes the dishes, and I set the dishes. Things suddenly become easier. 2. Is it clean? It is as clean as washing by hand, but the dishwasher is equipped with a dryer, so there is no need to drain the water, and it feels really good to not touch the wet water at the end. The corners and corners are washed very clean. If the corners and corners are clean by hand washing, it will be a bit troublesome. Looking at the clean glass and pot lid, I feel really comfortable. 3. Is the capacity enough? A family of three is enough, and sometimes we only need to wash in layers. But if the dishwasher conditions permit, you must buy a large one, because you will want to put all kinds of pots and pans in it and wash them clean. 4. Does it cost water and electricity? 10T is the second-level energy efficiency, and compared with *3000, it mainly consumes more power. But counting it down to dozens of yuan a year, compared to the price difference of several hundred, I think 10T is still very fragrant. I don't know exactly how much more water it costs than washing by hand, but I don't see my husband wasting water, so I don't waste water. 5. Are the consumables expensive? Count it down to about 1 yuan per time (including water and electricity). The disadvantage is that some people make a lot of noise when washing dishes. My house is an independent kitchen, and washing dishes somewhat affects watching TV or chatting in the living room. (You can solve this problem by making an appointment to wash it.) The master installer is also very careful. I removed the cabinet and a drawer for the oven in my house. I charged 320 yuan and took three hours. I think it is worth it.
Comments (Original): 目前使用一个月了，总结下来：“真的好用”。4.5分吧，洗葡萄**。1.节约时间。之前总觉得手洗也就是20分钟的事情，但实际体验下来，洗碗机似乎解决了一个每天都要做的**烦，老公冲碗，我摆碗，事情一下子变简单了。2.干净吗。跟手洗的一样干净，但是洗碗机带烘干啊，不用沥水，也不用最后摸到湿哒哒的水的感觉真的很好。边边角角都洗的很干净，手洗要是得边边角角都干净，就有些费事了。看着洗的透亮的玻璃杯和锅盖，心里真舒服。3.容量够吗。一家三口够，我们有时候只用分层洗就够了。但洗碗机条件允许的，一定要买大的，因为你会想把各种锅碗瓢盆都放进去洗的干干净净。4.费水费电吗。10T是二级能效，和*3000比主要是耗电多一些。但算下来一年多个几十块吧，相比大几百的差价，我觉得10T还是很香的。具体要比手洗多费多少水，我也算不清楚，但看不见老公浪费水，我就当不费水了。5.耗材贵吗。算下来*均一次1元左右吧（含水电）。缺点也是有的洗碗时候的声音不小，我家是**式厨房，洗碗的时候多少有点影响客厅看电视或者聊天。（可以通过预约洗来解决这个问题）师傅安装也很用心，我家拆了放烤箱的橱柜和一个抽屉，收了320块，耗时尽三个小时，我觉得值的。

Comments (English): [ Very good, but drying could be better ] || ---------------- || I have had this dishwasher for about two months and have been using it nearly every day. Overall, I like it a lot. It's well made, simple to use, very sturdy, and cleans effectively. I like the front display because you can easily see the time remaining. And I like the dirt sensor -- the dishwasher automatically adjusts the cycle length based on how dirthy the rinse water is. As a bonus, the instruction manual is written in clear, colloquial English. My main problem is with the way it dries. To get your dishes dry you'll either need to use a rinse aid, or the "extra dry" (extra hot) cycle. My solution has been to open the door a bit after the cycle runs. Not quite as convenient, but it works and avoids the extra chemicals and extra energy. When the dishwasher was new it emitted a strong odor of asphalt when it heated up -- like being on a newly paved road on a hot day -- that's what Bosch uses as insulation on the outside of the drum. I was warned about this, but I was startled by how strong it was. It eventually disipated, but was pretty unpleasant at first. There's also a chemical odor from inside the drum. Not as bad -- and that disipated, as well.

Sentence (English): So far our Bosch 800 Series dishwasher has performed extremely well.
Comments (English): [ Very Good But Not Perfect ] || ---------------- || So far our Bosch 800 Series dishwasher has performed extremely well. It cleans and dries our dishes and is very quiet. We, as well as our cat Gracie, like the red light indicating the dishwasher is running. However, my wife would like another indication of whether the washing and drying cycles are running or are complete. She also feels as though the trays, supports and tines could have been designed better to maximize loading, however, I don't find this to be a problem. Our installer informed us that Bosch requires, for warranty purposes, that the unit to be connected to a dedicated electrical circuit. Since ours was not, we had both the sink food disposal and previous dishwasher on the same circuit, we had to hire an electrician to separate the circuits for both the disposal and dishwasher. Our previous dishwasher kept losing little bits and pieces of plastic parts which ended up at the bottom of the unit next to the heating element and creating a burnt odor. So far none of this with the Bosch. Overall, a very good unit.

Sentence (English): I'm impressed with the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ modern and efficient ] || ---------------- || I'm impressed with the dishwasher. Starting with the design, it is very modern and anti-fingerprint, making it easy to clean. One thing that I really like is that it has several programs and the option to put it at half load. Since it works with steam, it leaves the glasses perfect and what surprised me is that when it's finished it doesn't make that annoying beep, instead it plays music and opens by itself, which is great for drying. It has three trays: the bottom one serves both for plates and for pots or pans because the skewers can be lowered, the middle one can be put in three different positions, in the photo I lowered it because I had tall glasses. The top tray is for cutlery, you can fit a lot! In short, very happy with the purchase.
Comments (Original): [ Moderno y eficiente ] || ---------------- || Estoy impresionada con el lavavajillas. Empezando por el diseño, es muy moderno y anti huellas, con lo cual es fácil de limpiar. Una cosa que me gusta mucho es que tiene varios programas y opción de ponerlo a media carga. Como funciona con vapor deja los vasos perfectos y lo que me ha sorprendido es que al terminar no hace ese pitido molesto, si no que suena una música y se abre solo, que es genial para que se vaya secando. Tiene tres bandejas: la de abajo te sirve tanto para platos como para cazuelas o sartenes porque los pinchos se pueden bajar, la del medio se puede poner en tres posiciones diferentes, en la foto yo la he bajado porque tenia vasos altos. La bandeja de arriba es para los cubiertos, te caben un montón!!! En definitiva, contentísima con la compra.

Sentence (English): I would rate this unit as zero if possible.
Comments (English): [ Feeling Duped ] || ---------------- || I would rate this unit as zero if possible. It falls short of its advertised reliability and high-end cleaning capabilities. While it performs well when it's working, its frequent failures are incredibly disappointing. I initially thought I received a defective unit, but after reading other reviews, it seems like this dishwasher is attractive in appearance but poorly constructed with cheap components. It's frustrating that a machine of this caliber fails so frequently and at such an early stage. Around the two-year mark, the diverter motor broke and had to be replaced, but the cost of repair was disproportionately high compared to the small part. Despite our dissatisfaction, we decided to move forward. However, just over three years later, it has failed again, this time with what appears to be the washer pump. It's unbelievable to encounter such a major issue like a washer pump malfunction after only three years of use. It's become a joke. We are now considering replacing it with a different brand rather than spending money on fixing our three-year-old dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This unit came with our new built retirement home which we occupied Jan 2023.
Comments (English): [ A Good Solid Machine! ] || ---------------- || This unit came with our new built retirement home which we occupied Jan 2023. With the term "retirement" you can imagine we have had many dishwashers up to this time including some nice brand names over the years. In our recent home, we started with a Jenn Air then replaced it in 2020 with a Whirlpool (oddly all in the same family as KitchenAid) after 21 years of service. The Whirlpool was still going strong when we sold our home in 2022 before moving into our new home. I really like the features much more than the Whirlpool we had and it is extremely quiet! My Apple Watch clocks noise well under 50 decibels, Because I am a bit of a pre-washer, I use the "quick wash" to finish the job with less water with all the dishes coming out great and in a shorter time. While we are still within 6 months of usage, we would highly recommend this unit to anyone looking for a great dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is a cleaning beast!
Comments (English): [ Why only 3 stars? ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is a cleaning beast! It is super quiet (I turned it on and thought I hadn't installed it correctly because I couldn't hear it even though I was standing right next to it). I can wash huge crab boiler pots and large skillets due to being able to raise and lower the middle rack, and the upper rack is perfect for utensils and other odds and ends. It has lots of great features and WiFi connectivity is a lot handier than I anticipated. So, why only 3 stars? Because the folding rack dividers are a pain in the butt! First of all, they fold when you don't want them to and—more importantly—the center hinge clip on every single row broke within the first year of use. I'm pretty handy so I used stainless steel wire to reattach the clips and that repair worked fine. However, now two of the eight lower rack wheels just popped off and it's impossible to simply pop the wheels back on because the bearing retainer rings broke and ball bearings went everywhere. Thankfully, I purchased Geek Squad protection so I don't have to pay more than $200 (Yes! More than $200! ) to get the bottom rack replaced, but the rack is on back order (Gee. Wonder why? ). Minor issue: Tub light goes off after a couple of minutes and I can't figure out how to keep it on. Like WiFi connectivity, I didn't know how handy a tub light would be until I had one. Unfortunately, it doesn't stay on while loading/unloading. Why even have a light if you can't control when it turns off? Bottom line, for a top money—for me, at least! —dishwasher there is no excuse for a component as important as the bottom rack to be so poorly designed that it breaks within months of purchase. Yo LG! I love your brand but come on! You can do better than this! I cannot recommend this dishwasher. There are too many other good options out there.

Bottom rack: bars on the bottom of the bottom rack are spaced wide apart--can't load all the things I was able to load on that with my GE Adora dishwasher. Runs fine--like the variety wash options--the extra dry button for that "fan" they talk about--doesn't dry as well as my GE Adora did. :( I do like that you can easily remove the filter to clean it.

Sentence (English): My old Bosch dishwasher (14 years old) was broken and beyond repair, so I got this one as a replacement.
Comments (English): [ Modern, flexible, but hums quite a bit ] || ---------------- || My old Bosch dishwasher (14 years old) was broken and beyond repair, so I got this one as a replacement. It generally has cool features – the app is a nice gadget, especially because you can easily adjust settings, the many foldable spinners in the dish drawers are advantageous as they offer a lot of flexibility, and the interior lighting is cool. Noise: Overall, it's quieter than my old one, but for the last hour (on the eco program) it only hums during drying (zeolite drying). The noise is really disgusting and gives me headaches. We have an open kitchen with a dining area and living room, and if you don't have any other TV or music on, it's a really piercing noise that you can't escape. With my old dishwasher, you could hear more overall, but it was more of a soothing water splashing sound. Bottom line: the appliance is switched on when we leave the apartment or when there are likely to be distracting noises.
Comments (Original): [ Modern, flexibel, brummt aber ganz schön ] || ---------------- || Mein alter Geschirrspüler vom Bosch (14 Jahre alt) war defekt und irreparabel, also kam dieser hier als Ersatz. Grundsätzlich hat er coole Funktionen – die App ist ein nettes Gadget, vor allem weil man Einstellungen leicht vornehmen kann, die vielen klappbaren Stacheln in den Geschirrschubladen vorteilhaft da viel Flexibilität, Licht innen cool.Geräusch, insgesamt leiser, als mein alter, aber die letzte Stunde (beim Eco-Programm) brummt er nur noch beim Trocknen (Zeolith-Trockung). Das Geräusch ist echt eklig und macht Kopfschmerzen. Wir haben eine offene Küche mit Essbereich und Wohnzimmer und wenn man sonst keinen Fernseher oder Musik anhat ist das echt ein durchdringendes Geräusch, dem man sich nicht entziehen kann. Bei meinem alten Geschirrspüler hat man insgesamt mehr gehört, aber eher beruhigende Wasser-Spritz-Geräusche. Fazit: das Gerät wird angeschaltet, wenn wir die Wohnung verlassen oder Ablenkungsgeräusche haben können ...

Sentence (English): I replace the 1 year old GE Profile DW at my new vacation home with this model.
Comments (English): [ Second KitchenAid DW ] || ---------------- || I replace the 1 year old GE Profile DW at my new vacation home with this model. Could not stand the GE. I already have a last generation model at my home. So, I am mostly comparing those two. First, KitchenAid DW are the best out there in terms of cleaning, loading, and excellent racks and sliders. This new model has slightly better cleaning and with the 3rd rack and definitely hold a lot more. With that said, there are some things that I like better on the last generation. My model KDTM384ESS, is quieter, you can not even tell if it is running. It is the unique one with the glass window in the door, so maybe that makes a difference. Also, the older model has much better LED lighting. The lights are at the top and illuminate the all the insides very well. This new generation model has light at the top of the side walls and does a very poor job of lighting the interior. The installation is a lot easier on this new model too. Love the drip pan with a leak sensor. But, all in all, I am pleased with this product.

Even with the middle rack adjusted to its lowest level (very easy to adjust), there's plenty of room for our largest dishes. And the middle rack will hold larger (fatter) mugs in the outer rows without bending the holding tines (our previous dishwasher couldn't do this). There's even a full-sized utensil basket on the lower rack, with flip-up holders for larger items.2. Third Rack: The third rack on top also has washer nozzles. These are working very well to clean small mugs and, yes, my favorite steak knives.3. Noise. This dishwasher is not loud at all; very quiet. It's not as quiet as the previous Kitchenaid dishwasher we had but it is easy to carry on a quiet conversation even while standing next to the dishwasher while it is in operation. Very pleasant.4. The control interface is easy to use, and the soft beeping sounds and timer display are great conveniences to know that it is starting or how much time remains. With my countertop that overhangs the top control panel, there's just enough room for me to bend over and peek in to read the count-down timer.5. Price. This dishwasher was about $400 cheaper than an equivalent Bosch or Kitchenaid dishwasher with similar features. 6. Reliability. Consumer Reports rated this Whirlpool series just below Bosch, in terms of reliability, and a bit above the equivalent Kitchenaid. Although there was more plastic components in critical drain hose connection areas on this one, they appear to be mounted and sturdy. 7. Leak-preventer? There is a float-tray underneath the door, concealed by the front apron, which has two rubber hoses that appear to redirect any potential overflow. it appears that this will automatically stop the dishwasher if an issue prevents proper drainage which would result in overflow. This is a great feature, as our previous dishwasher leaked out onto our floor when the drain pump failed. So, this adds some measure of confidence that our floor may be protected from being flooded in the event an issue develops.8. Installation. using a small bubble level, during installation (per the instructions) makes a big difference for ensuring everything will function properly, which includes ensuring the door seals properly and drainage systems work properly.9. Rack rails and wheels. The wheels that the lower rack rides on appear to be better designed to be less prone to binding or breaking, compared to our previous older Kitchenaid. I presume that Whirlpool has been working hard to improve reliable function. The middle and upper racks roll-out easily on their tracks, too. 10. Installation challenge. The greatest challenge was affixing the two small steel brackets and feeding screws through the holes (one on each side) to secure the dishwasher to the surrounding kitchen cabinet structure. I recommend you use a screwdriver with a magnetic tip to help hold the screws as you carefully insert the screw through the holes. I used slightly larger and longer screws, than the ones provided with the dishwasher, to ensure a secure mount. The smaller screws may not handle the stress of daily opening and closing the door several times, as one typically may load a few dishes here or there throughout the day. Our previous dishwasher had the smaller screws too and they eventually worked themselves loose. larger, longer screws will maintain a hold better. So far, our installation seems to be rock-solid.

Even with the middle rack adjusted to its lowest level (very easy to adjust), there's plenty of room for our largest dishes. And the middle rack will hold larger (fatter) mugs in the outer rows without bending the holding tines (our previous dishwasher couldn't do this). There's even a full-sized utensil basket on the lower rack, with flip-up holders for larger items.2. Third Rack: The third rack on top also has washer nozzles. These are working very well to clean small mugs and, yes, my favorite steak knives.3. Noise. This dishwasher is not loud at all; very quiet. It's not as quiet as the previous Kitchenaid dishwasher we had but it is easy to carry on a quiet conversation even while standing next to the dishwasher while it is in operation. Very pleasant.4. The control interface is easy to use, and the soft beeping sounds and timer display are great conveniences to know that it is starting or how much time remains. With my countertop that overhangs the top control panel, there's just enough room for me to bend over and peek in to read the count-down timer.5. Price. This dishwasher was about $400 cheaper than an equivalent Bosch or Kitchenaid dishwasher with similar features. 6. Reliability. Consumer Reports rated this Whirlpool series just below Bosch, in terms of reliability, and a bit above the equivalent Kitchenaid. Although there was more plastic components in critical drain hose connection areas on this one, they appear to be mounted and sturdy. 7. Leak-preventer? There is a float-tray underneath the door, concealed by the front apron, which has two rubber hoses that appear to redirect any potential overflow. it appears that this will automatically stop the dishwasher if an issue prevents proper drainage which would result in overflow. This is a great feature, as our previous dishwasher leaked out onto our floor when the drain pump failed. So, this adds some measure of confidence that our floor may be protected from being flooded in the event an issue develops.8. Installation. using a small bubble level, during installation (per the instructions) makes a big difference for ensuring everything will function properly, which includes ensuring the door seals properly and drainage systems work properly.9. Rack rails and wheels. The wheels that the lower rack rides on appear to be better designed to be less prone to binding or breaking, compared to our previous older Kitchenaid. I presume that Whirlpool has been working hard to improve reliable function. The middle and upper racks roll-out easily on their tracks, too. 10. Installation challenge. The greatest challenge was affixing the two small steel brackets and feeding screws through the holes (one on each side) to secure the dishwasher to the surrounding kitchen cabinet structure. I recommend you use a screwdriver with a magnetic tip to help hold the screws as you carefully insert the screw through the holes. I used slightly larger and longer screws, than the ones provided with the dishwasher, to ensure a secure mount. The smaller screws may not handle the stress of daily opening and closing the door several times, as one typically may load a few dishes here or there throughout the day. Our previous dishwasher had the smaller screws too and they eventually worked themselves loose. larger, longer screws will maintain a hold better. So far, our installation seems to be rock-solid.

This not only raises durability concerns but is also a misrepresentation of the product, leading to disappointment. Despite its commendable noise reduction and pleasing appearance, the misleading description regarding the tub material is a significant drawback. Buyers seeking a dishwasher with a stainless steel tub, as per the product description, will be let down. For this reason, it receives three out of five stars.

If this dishwasher operates like our last Bosch, it will last years to come and the dishes it washes are as clean as you can imagine. Great performance with nice design and Bosch reputation for reliability. You truly get what you pay for with this dishwasher.
